in_hebrew.name: Heilner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Heilner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic words heil (health, salvation) and ner (knower, adviser). This name was given to those who provided aid and comfort during times of need. In the Christian context, it can be seen as a reminder of the healing power of God.
